reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch and gave it a positive review, but did not address the concerns raised by Gregory.

2026-09-07.patch_summary: This patch refactors the memoryless node check in mm/memory_hotplug.c by extracting it into a separate function, node_is_memoryless(). The existing check_no_memblock_for_node_cb() helper is also moved ahead of the add/online path for clarity. The patch introduces no functional changes.
